dataList.content:
All that remained on the rooftop was a burnt Golden Bough inside the coffin.
屋顶上只剩下棺材里烧尽的一根金枝。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Rooftop
呼啸山庄 屋顶

dataList.content:
The Golden Bough is burnt white. It appears that someone has made off with the other.
金枝被烧成了白色。剩下的一根似乎已经被其他人拿走了。

<Nelly... took the other one. The one that's intact.>
<完好无缺的那根……被耐莉拿走了。>

She must've taken it to her.
应该是拿给她了吧。

... Hermann.
……赫尔曼。

This isn't a failure.
还没失败呢。

We'll get it back.
我们会取回来的。

Even if our hearts may be broken apart, if I give it my all... we'll be connected once again.
哪怕两颗心曾经相悖……只要付出真心……就一定能再次相连。

As they did, even in the world where Catherine and I were both dead.
就算是在我和凯瑟琳一同死去的世界里也一样。

Is Catherine... the name of the person in this coffin?
棺材里的人的名字……是凯瑟琳吗？

I'm sorry, everything feels so... foggy...
对不起，好像记忆都雾蒙蒙的……

The coffin and the person that lies within will be taken back to the headquarters by the After Team.
棺材和其中的人将会一同被LCCA回收，并移交至本部。

I wanted to ask him if he was okay, but... I already knew the answer. So many things had gone wrong.
虽然我想问他还好吗，但相悖出错的事太多了。

No. I'm still... not okay.
还……不是很好。

Heathcliff's one and only goal... was gone.
希斯克利夫唯一的目标已经消失。

But Heathcliff was no longer trapped in a living dream.
然而，那一直困在梦中的希斯克利夫也不复存在……

... Perhaps that is precisely why he could open the door to see a new, wider world.
或许正因此，希斯克利夫才能打开门，看向更广阔的世界。

Not a single color remained in the silent Wuthering Heights once the tempest passed.
暴风雨终于停息，沉寂下来的呼啸山庄再无任何色彩。

All monochromatic, save for...
但还有……

... patches of color...
唯一，仍留有颜色的……

Those flowers... are called heath.
那些花的名字……是<ruby=Heath>石南</ruby>。

The loneliest flowers that take root and bloom in the wild moorlands... But they're also flowers that survive no matter what devastating tempest comes their way. They endure it all and wait.
它们在荒野里孤独地绽放……即使饱受风雨摧残也会顽强存活……忍受一切，等待着。

<Wait for... what?>
<等待什么？>

I don't know. The time, I suppose.
谁知道，可能是……时间。

That is when Heathcliff finally told us the name of the flowers.
希斯克利夫终于说出了那些花的名字。

Woahh! Go after it! GO!
哦哦哦？快追！往那儿跑了！
dataList.place:
Backstreets of T Corp.
T公司后巷 某处

dataList.content:
Oi, it took off. Where the bloody hell are you lookin' at?!
不对，它在那边消失了。你在看哪儿呢！

Well, maybe you should've told me that first?!
您应该早点说啊！

Another day, another Distortion hunting in the streets of T Corp. as per LCD's orders.
在T公司某处移动的我们，正和上次一样遵照LCD的命令，在追踪指定的扭曲。

Looks like it didn't take too long for Heathcliff to be his usual energetic self once agai—
幸好希斯克利夫恢复得很快……

Oi, I told you to send 'em this way! I'll smash your head in once this is over!
喂！想死是吧？我让你拿来！

... Maybe he's gotten too passionate.
……不仅如此，还比以往更有热情了。

<Long time no— Wait. Why are you... how do you still have color?>
<好久不……奇怪，你怎么……还带着颜色？>

dataList.content:
Because the light is yet to reach me.
因为光还没有触及我。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Because a star is an unfathomable distance away.
因为星星遥不可及。

dataList.content:
Do you like flowers too, Dante?
但丁，你喜欢花吗？

<I think I've come to like them.>
<我觉得我今后会喜欢上了。>

dataList.content:
Imagine that there was a single rose you've taken care of for a long time.
试想，有一朵你精心呵护的玫瑰。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Your room was always brimming from the sweet aroma of that flower.
而你的房间被那花香充盈。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
But one day, you leave the rose behind to go on a long, long journey.
可某一日，你踏上漫长的旅途，却将那玫瑰留下了。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
In your journey, you come across a large garden... and there, you see thousands of the very same rose you once cared for. That sight... brings you to tears, and you drop to your knees.
你在旅途中来到了宽阔的花园……遇到了数千朵和你曾经照料过的那朵相同的玫瑰……见到那幅景色，你泪流满面，不禁跪倒在地。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
... Why do you suppose that is?
你觉得这是为什么？

Demian... he's appeared before me in the past. He would always leave me with these cryptic riddles.
德米安，这个以往只是在我面前稍一露面便消失的人，总会给我留下这样奇特的谜题。

But I'm starting to understand what his riddles are supposed to represent.
但我似乎能隐约领悟到这些谜题代表的东西了。

<Because I've finally come to understand.>
<因为我发现了。>

<That the one I truly loved was the rose I'd left behind.>
<我真正所爱的，是自己留下的那一朵玫瑰。>

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Correct.
没错。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Even though there are thousands of roses in this world, there is but one rose that is mine.
即使世间有千千万万朵玫瑰，属于我的玫瑰仅仅只是那一朵。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
You've watered it diligently, cared for it, even as its thorns pricked your fingers. So that your care makes its aroma bloom.
因为那是你灌溉而呵护，虽然偶尔会刺伤自己，却因你而散发芬芳的花。

dataList.title:

？？？
dataList.content:
I suppose that's how it was for Heathcliff and Catherine as well. Knowing that there are infinite Catherines and Heathcliffs in countless worlds... they wished not for the happiness of infinite Catherines and Heathcliffs but for the happiness of each other. Because to them, each other was the one that truly mattered.
希斯克利夫和凯瑟琳或许也是如此吧？即使知道每个世界都存在希斯克利夫和凯瑟琳……可比起希望所有的希斯克利夫和凯瑟琳能获得幸福，他们也更希望去珍惜眼前特别的彼此。

dataList.title:

？？？
dataList.content:
But it would take most people a long, long time to understand that. Because most people are foolish.
然而大多数人都是愚昧的，他们需要经历漫长的时间才能认识到这一点。

dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Do you understand? Once I learn to properly love my very own flower...
明白吗？只要领悟了如何珍爱眼前独属于自己的花……

dataList.title:

？？？
dataList.content:
I no longer need to protect the thousands of other roses in the world.
自那一刻起，便不必再去守护其余那千千万万朵玫瑰了。

dataList.title:

？？？
dataList.content:
People of this star care for thousands of rose blossoms in their own gardens... but still fail to find what they really desire.
这星球上的人们为了装点自己的花园，养育了万千玫瑰，却寻不得自己真心期盼的东西。

<... But what of the other flowers that have already bloomed?>
<……但那些已经绽放的花呢？>

<What happens to them?>
<它们会怎样？>

Demian smiled at my question.
听了我的疑问，德米安微微一笑。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
You will find the answer to that question yourself...
那份答案就等到你为我画羊的时候吧。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
... when you can draw me a sheep.
那时你自己就会寻找到答案的。

With that, Demian disappeared.
话音刚落，德米安就消失不见了。

... I hear the faint cry of a distant lamb.
……不知从何处传来了微弱的羊叫声。
